description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order under Section 8 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, amending a previous order. It deals with regulatory matters concerning foreign exchange, specifically extending an amnesty period. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5), which cover statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and legal amendments. While a minister's name is present, the core content is about regulatory changes, not government personnel or structural changes, so government types (1-3) do not take precedence.
